scenarios.covers: stream: dropped after a heartbeat and not reconnecting → the safety poll keeps fetching at its interval, not at the interval of a held stream
scenarios.name: server: a stream that drops after being connected and stays down brings the next fetch within the safety poll

steps.note: the preamble and the version held
a heartbeat: the stream is stable
closed by the server after a heartbeat
a routine close waits 0–2 s; the stream stays down
first failure: backoff from 1 s
second failure: the backoff doubles
third failure: the backoff doubles again
the safety poll, 30 s after the last fetch although the stream is down, brings the change
